commands.pickDate_comment: Command palette entry. Opens the picker for the date at the cursor.

trigger.name_comment: Settings row label for the dropdown controlling how the picker offers itself on a recognised date.
trigger.name: Trigger
trigger.description_comment: Settings row description under the Trigger label.
trigger.description: How the picker appears on a date in your note.

options.hover-icon_comment: Dropdown option: a small icon appears beside the date only while the pointer is over it.
options.double-click_comment: Dropdown option: double-clicking the date opens the picker, so a single click still just places the cursor.
options.both_comment: Dropdown option: both the hover icon and the double-click gesture are active.

notices.notImplemented_comment: Placeholder notice shown by the stub command while the picker itself is unbuilt.
notices.notImplemented: The date picker isn't built yet.
